children: may retrace into a range of $106.02 to $107.01 per barrel, following its failure to break a resistance at $109.58.
The failure was symbolized by a big black candle, which forms a bearish harami cross with the preceding small white candle.
Increasing the likelihood of the correction is the completion of a five-wave cycle from around $100. The bottom of the wave 4 about $107 serves as a correction target.
The uptrend is expected to resume upon the completion of the correction, as the strong bullish momentum accumulated during the previous trading session is likely to push the market higher.

On the daily chart, the market faces a key resistance at $110.24, the 100% projection level of a wave C from $78.19. This barrier seems to have triggered a pullback toward $104.91, the 61.8% retracement of the downtrend from $126.41.
